theorems.name: Submission.ts_pwb_density_points_of_image_ae
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (C : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → Ambient n ℓ), MeasurableSet C → (∃ K : NNReal, LipschitzWith K F) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)), ∀ w ∈ C, F w = x → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ volume (C ∩ closedBall w r) / volume (closedBall w r)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
